text:
Marta: Updated compare-table mock & toolbar up on Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Main asks: make perf badges sortable, simplify pin UX (no modal), and add a compact filter row. PTAL.

Anna: Nice — quick Qs: how do badges behave on mobile? is pinning per-user or per-project?

Sam: Badges should be icon + short text (not full chips) so row height stays small. Mobile: hide less-important badges behind an overflow '⋯' menu.

Kevin: Pin should be project-scoped by default; user-scoped pins are an advanced option. We need copy options: 'Pin version to this project' vs 'Pin version for you' — shorter preferred.

Jules: A11y nits: badges need explicit aria-labels and visible focus rings. Don’t rely on color alone to communicate perf tier (e.g., gold/silver). Ensure contrast >= 4.5 for badge text.

Priya: Impl note: compare table is virtualized. Adding a fixed pin column could break measurements — might be safer to surface pin action in the toolbar or as an inline toggle that’s part of the virtual row render.

Carlos: From support metrics, users rarely compare >3 models at once. Suggest default collapse to 3 items with a 'Show more' to avoid horizontal scroll on smaller screens.

Marta: Proposed toolbar layout: left = filters + search, center = compact status (e.g., "Comparing 2/3") + collapse toggle, right = actions (Pin all / Export / Manage pins). Badges stay above model name in a single-line row, small icon + label.

Anna: Copy tweak suggestion: use 'Pin model version' (short) and tooltip: 'Keep this version as the default for new deployments in this project.'

Sam: Keyboard accessibility: pin must be a focusable toggle button with aria-pressed. After an action show an ephemeral snackbar: 'Pinned v1.3 — Undo'. Also, implement focus management so the keyboard flow doesn't jump.

Jules: For SR users, emit a live region update on pin/unpin: e.g., "Version 1.3 pinned for Project Redwood". Also ensure badge tooltips are accessible via keyboard (not just hover).

Priya: I'll prototype styles: try flex with overflow-x:auto for the row; for mobile collapse badges into a single button that opens a popover. If that’s flaky with virtualization, we can render critical badges only and keep 'more' in a popover.

Marta: UX decision (proposed): non-modal inline pin toggle in each row + 'Manage pins' in toolbar for bulk/unpin. Badges are compact icons with text, sortable via a small dropdown in the toolbar.

Kevin: :thumbsup: Let's aim for a beta rollout next sprint. Any blockers?

Carlos: One more: perf badges should link to a perf details page for that model-version (latency P50/P95, memory). Users want quick drilldowns.

Anna: Agree but avoid noise — maybe the badges' tooltip has a 'View metrics' link instead of always linking.

Jules: Also use non-color indicators for perf tier (icons/labels) and test against common colorblind palettes.

Marta: I'll update the Figma with the toolbar/row changes, add the a11y annotations and copy tweaks. New Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz?updated. PRD update by EOD.

Sam: I'll spike the virtualization impact tomorrow and post findings in this thread.

Priya: I'll stub mobile styles and hand off to QA for keyboard/a11y checks.

Kevin: Great — scheduling a short design-review slot on Thursday to sign off. Thanks everyone.
